types/utils.ts/Overwrite: only overwrite keys of objects

Overwrite<string,string> resulted in a mangled object type
because the existing implementation iterated over the string
type's keys (e.g. 'charCodeAt')

This commit changes the implementation so that keys are only
iterated and overwritten in the case of objects. Otherwise,
a non-never TWith type will entirely replace TType, e.g.
Overwrite<string, number> results in 'number'.

summary.intent: Fix input/output inference for procedures that combine .input() with .use() middleware by making the internal Overwrite type replace TType wholesale unless both sides are objects (commit-7dc04a7/"only overwrite keys of objects"); add a regression test.
summary.issue_fit: Met. No originating issue or spec; the PR body is an empty template, so intent comes from the real commit messages. Overwrite<string,string> and Overwrite<string,number> now resolve to the replacing type.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff (2 files) reviewed with callers of Overwrite in procedureBuilder.ts and middleware.ts. Reviewer-executed at head: `cd packages/tests && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` exit 0 (includes the new regression test). Scratch tsc probe of old vs new Overwrite confirmed string/string -> string, string/never -> never, unknown/{a:1} -> {a:1}. Runtime vitest not run per policy. No mandatory verification candidates or safety-premise areas, so no verifier batch was dispatched.

observations.fact: The `: TType` fallback in the non-object branch of the new Overwrite is unreachable, since `TWith extends any` is always true and a never TWith distributes to never; the doc comment's 'unless TWith is never' therefore yields never, not TType.
observations.evidence: `packages/server/src/core/internals/utils.ts:11-31`; scratch tsc probe: Overwrite<string, never> = never.

observations.fact: Arrays and functions are objects, so Overwrite<string[], string[]> still key-maps into a garbled mapped type exactly as before the change; the fix covers primitives only.
observations.evidence: `packages/server/src/core/internals/utils.ts:11-14`; scratch tsc probe of old and new definitions.

observations.fact: The regression test declares `voidWithMiddleware` but never asserts on it.
